name: Nobis Hotel Copenhagen
positioning: Hotel in the old Royal Danish Academy of Music building in central Copenhagen, with interiors designed with Swedish architect Gert Wingardh
best_for: Travelers who want a walkable base next to Tivoli Gardens and Central Station
Guests who appreciate historic buildings with contemporary Scandinavian design

facts.text: The hotel is next to Tivoli Gardens.
The hotel is next to Copenhagen Central Station and City Hall Square.
The hotel is next to the Ny Carlsberg Glyptotek museum.
The hotel is in a historic building from 1903.
Room types include a Junior Suite Loft and a Superior Loft.
Booking on the hotel's own website includes a Travel Assistance Service with full medical assistance during the stay.
Restaurant NOI serves a menu with influences from all over Europe.
NOI's private dining room, Chambre Separee, is suitable for 14 dinner guests.

highlights.text: The hotel occupies the old building of the Royal Danish Academy of Music.
The interior was designed in co-operation with Swedish architect Gert Wingardh.
The hotel has a courtyard where guests can enjoy cocktails.
The suites include the Nobis Suite and the Penthouse Suite, for one to four people.
The Marble Bar is surrounded by Nordic designs and Italian marble.

considerations.text: The setting is central and urban, next to Copenhagen Central Station and City Hall Square.
WhataHotel notes a busy city center location with typical urban noise levels.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
